Headline: #147 Outer DuSable Temporary Southbound Reroute near Rogers/Clark
ShortDescription: SB #147 Outer Drive Express buses are temporarily rerouted due to a street blockage near Rogers/Clark.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Southbound #147 Outer Drive Express buses are temporarily rerouted via Howard Terminal, Howard, Clark, Rogers, Sheridan and over regular route, due to a street blockage near Rogers/Clark.

Northbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.
